summary: Iteration 2 backend testing complete. All 14 pytest tests passed (100%). Covered new endpoints: GET /api/exercises (catalog with expected named movements), POST /api/videos (upload with valid mp4 returns record with id/url/size), GET /api/videos (list), GET /api/videos/by-exercise (single lookup), StaticFiles serve at /api/uploads/<filename>, one-video-per-exercise replacement (old file unlinked, only one record remains), 400 on bad file type (text/plain non-video ext), DELETE /api/videos/{id} + subsequent by-exercise returns {video:null}. Regression on /api/health, /api/program, /api/sessions/full-body-a, /api/state, /api/logs all passed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 295 uses find(...).to_list(100) then deletes; acceptable but a simple find/delete loop is fine. No _id leakage — projections consistently exclude _id. Good.
Video content_type validation accepts extension OR video/* — matches spec. Bad-type test (text/plain + .txt) correctly returns 400.
StaticFiles mounted AFTER include_router as required — /api/uploads serves file bytes with 200; deleted files 404 correctly.
Consider adding data-testid attributes on the frontend Videos page (not tested here — backend-only scope).
seed_data_creation: Used /tmp/tiny.mp4 (2240 bytes, ffmpeg-generated). All uploaded videos were cleaned up via DELETE at end of test class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_videos.py exercises all iteration-2 endpoints + iteration-1 regressions. Fixture generates/uses /tmp/tiny.mp4. Runs under pytest-xdist (LoadScope) — TestVideos class stays on one worker so class-level state (created_ids/first_id) is safe. All 14 tests pass against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
